name: deliveredsms
description: Official client + CLI for Delivered (deliveredsms.com): SMS, phone verification, and phone numbers. Zero dependencies.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "const{renameSync,rmSync,readFileSync,writeFileSync,chmodSync}=require('fs');renameSync('dist-cjs/index.js','dist/index.cjs');const cli=readFileSync('dist-cjs/cli.js','utf8').replace('require(\"./index\")','require(\"./index.cjs\")');writeFileSync('dist/cli.cjs',cli);chmodSync('dist/cli.cjs',0o755);rmSync('dist-cjs',{recursive:true,force:true})"
